g.text: One cached decode step at batch one · Median synchronized wall time

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17282f

g.text: The split-context control ran only in isolated attention at 64 and 4,096 tokens. The stack includes projections, routing and eight active experts per layer.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #43565e

g.text: Whiskers show paired 95% bootstrap intervals within the two recorded sessions. Each median pools 200 timing blocks per method.
